# The only words a fixture is allowed to contain.
#
# Every spoken token of every fixture is replaced by one of these, chosen by a stable hash of the
# original word, so the same word always becomes the same one and a term repeated in the meeting
# is still repeated in the fixture. Nothing here names a person, a company or a product.
#
# The list being closed is what makes the privacy claim checkable instead of promised: a test
# reads this file and fails if a fixture holds a word that is not in it. Adding a word is
# allowed; it only widens what the tests will accept, so keep it as neutral as this.
#
# Comments and blank lines are ignored. One word per line, lower case, no punctuation.
